title: Show only processes for a specific user
summary: Use the `top` command with the `-user` flag to filter the process list so it only shows processes owned by a specific username. This is useful for isolating activity for one account.

steps.explain: Run `top` with the `-user` flag followed by the username to display only processes owned by that user.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username whose processes you want to see.

steps.expect: The process list appears, filtered to show only processes owned by the specified user.
